about.title: About [[vendor_name]]
text:
[[vendor_name]] is a contractor based in [[town]]. [[owner]] leads the crew. We build houses and commercial buildings, carry out civil works such as roads, drains and walls, and do electrical contracting in [[area]] and nearby places.

Every job page lists the scope, a typical duration and an indicative rate, so you know what to expect before the site visit.

[[vendor_name]] takes building, civil and electrical jobs across [[town]]. Under [[owner]], our masons, supervisors and electricians work to a plan and a written estimate.

Browse the kinds of work we do and send an enquiry for the one you need.

We are [[vendor_name]], contractors in [[area]]. [[owner]] visits every site, explains the work in plain words and gives a quote in writing.

Look through the jobs below, then ask us for a free site visit.
